background: OP Financial Group is Finland's largest financial group, a cooperative owned by its member banks and their customers, funded by Finnish deposits and covered bonds and lending to Finnish households and companies, with a large insurance arm.
synthesis: S&P rates the group AA- and Moody's Aa3, both stable. The ratios are strong across the board against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 21.2%, leverage of 11.3% and LCR of 191% are all in the top quarter, against medians of 16.4%, 5.5% and 151%, and NSFR of 130% is above the 124% median. Leverage has risen 0.8 points since 30 Jun 2025 and the rest has been flat. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. One of the best-capitalised banking groups in Europe, with a cooperative structure under which the member banks are jointly liable.
